your_book:
Friday's session was a broadly positive one for Jaleel's book, with the majority of holdings finishing in the green and the healthcare/medtech complex doing most of the heavy lifting. Zoetis (ZTS, ~10.9% of the book) was the standout, adding 2.37% on the day — welcome momentum for a name still sitting 5.0% underwater on an unrealized basis. On Holding (ONON) posted the session's best gain at +3.08%, while Gilead (GILD, +2.77%) and Lululemon (LULU, +1.96%) also contributed. Boston Scientific (BSX, +1.64%) and Abbott (ABT, +1.13%) continued to grind higher in what remains a medtech-heavy book. The lone drags were Expand Energy (EXE, -0.72%) and NVIDIA (NVDA, -0.52%), where headline noise around OpenAI's revenue being overstated weighed on the broader AI-compute complex — Broadcom (AVGO) also saw a muted day in that context.

The drift-and-divergence list is worth naming honestly. BSX carries an elevated risk flag after its FY26 growth guide was slashed from 10.5% to 7–8.5%, yet the verdict remains STRONG BUY and it holds a ~9.1% weight — price and thesis are moving in opposite directions, and the next update arrives October 28. LULU is the starkest case: down 26.1% since entry, flagged for a guidance cut, Americas comps in a fifth consecutive negative quarter, and China stalled — yet it's rated STRONG BUY. The market is clearly pricing something the model isn't. RKLB sits at -13.0% on the position with an AVOID verdict and a 7.6% weight; that combination is the most direct structural tension in the book.

Heading into Monday, October 12, the book's overall unrealized loss of -2.33% is concentrated in a handful of names — LULU, BSX, RKLB, and Neurocrine (NBIX, -12.6%) — while the larger-weight winners like ABT and NVDA provide some offset. The pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) faces a policy-overhang event flagged for October 22; watch for any MFN pricing headlines over the weekend. ABT reports October 21 and BSX on October 28 — those two together represent roughly a fifth of the book.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated at 7.6% weight, down 13% — why is this still here?
attention.note: RKLB is the only holding with a hard AVOID verdict, yet it commands the fifth-largest weight in a capital-preservation book and is already 13% in the red; that combination demands an explicit hold rationale or a sizing decision before Monday.

attention.headline: Down 26.1% with a guidance cut flagged — thesis vs. price gap is widening
attention.note: Five straight negative Americas comp quarters, tariff margin damage, and a stalled China business have driven a 26% loss on the position, yet the model rates it STRONG BUY; the next catalyst isn't until December 9, leaving the position exposed for two more months without a check-in.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed; earnings due October 28 are the next hard test
attention.note: Boston Scientific cut FY26 growth guidance to 7–8.5% from 10.5%, management is guiding flat through Q3, and the position is already -12.8% — October 28 earnings will confirm whether the reset is complete or whether another cut is coming.

attention.headline: Drug-pricing policy event flagged for October 22 — pharma cluster at risk
attention.note: With MFN pricing deals already signed by Gilead and Novartis and an October 22 policy date on the calendar, any escalation in import tariffs or pricing mandates could move the entire pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) simultaneously.
